tracking: ADR-0338 (lane E19): vendor agent control admin routes, API-only in slice 1; screen requested on #453

gaps.POST /v1/vendor-agent-control/actions: requests a disable, quarantine or restore of a discovered vendor agent (settings_relax step-up, then a second administrator's approval; audited; off until the org switch is on)
gaps.GET /v1/vendor-agent-control/actions: lists vendor agent control actions, newest first, with each one's lifecycle
gaps.GET /v1/vendor-agent-control/actions/:id: one vendor agent control action, its lifecycle and the kill-switch guard's reason when execute is refused
gaps.POST /v1/vendor-agent-control/actions/:i: the requester executes an approved action once, with a fresh step-up; the vendor is called through the guarded fetch and the outcome is audited
settles an action whose outcome is unknown by reading the vendor state only (step-up, never a second call)
cancels an action before it runs and withdraws its approval (audited, no step-up)
